name: Contract_0x7657
fix_description: Function 0x0a8fe064 has no access control - anyone can call it to set storage[0x06] to their address and receive ETH via the subsequent call. The contract has an isAdmin() role system but this function does not check it. Fix: add require(isAdmin(msg.sender)) check.
difficulty_reasoning: The PoC is essentially a direct call into the vulnerable contract with crafted parameters to drain a victim’s USDT balance, plus a simple callback function to receive the tokens. It is a very short, single-path exploit with no flash loans, pricing logic, or complex protocol interactions.
